title: Purple Sweet Potato Soup With Crispy Lotus Root Chips

ingredientSections.heading: Purple Potato Soup
items: ½ tsp (2g) black pepper, or to taste

ingredientSections.heading: Garnish
items: 15 lotus root chips (see above) or purple sweet potatoes chips
*Optional spices: ¼ tsp ground nutmeg and ¼ tsp ground cloves

methodSections.heading: Lotus Root Chips
steps: Chop off the ends of the lotus roots and peel them just like a potato.
Using a mandolin or sharp knife, slice the roots into thin slices. The thinner they are the crisper they’ll be.
Place in a big bowl and coat with the olive oil, salt, pepper and a bit of sesame oil.
Spread the lotus root slices in a single layer on a dehydrator tray and dehydrate at 45°C (115°F) for 10 hours or until crispy.
If you don’t have a dehydrator, you can also bake them in the oven at 160°C (325°F) spread out in a single layer after liberally brushing them with avocado oil.

methodSections.heading: Purple Potato Soup
steps: Bake potatoes and sweet potatoes wrapped in foil at 180°C (350°F) for 50 minutes. When cooked remove the skin and dice roughly.
Dice the onions and slice the garlic finely.
In a large pot, heat the avocado oil, add the garlic and sautée for 1-2 minutes.
Add the onion, salt and the pepper and cook for about 5 minutes, stirring regularly, until onions are tender.
Add the water, potatoes and all remaining soup ingredients and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes.
Transfer the mixture to a blender and blend until smooth. Adjust the seasoning by adding salt and pepper to taste.
Top with green onion, black or sesame seeds, dark green raw pumpkin oil and lotus root chips. Optionally, sprinkle with ground nutmeg or ground cloves.
